originalReading:
CG 1st MARDIV (Rein) message 238952 activated BLT 2/5 to be
effective 250001 March 1966.  The operational and administrative control
of the BLT was shifted from RLT-5 to the 9th MAB on 300101 March 1966 by
the same message.
replacement:
CG 1st MARDIV (Rein) message 230005Z activated BLT 2/5 to be
effective 250001 March 1966.  The operational and administrative control
of the BLT was shifted from RLT-5 to the 9th MAB on 300101 March 1966 by
the same message.
author: Brent Tyler
reason: Brent confirmed Qwen’s 230005Z reading in command-and-control item D.1 on PDF page 6.
